title: Closing-restaurant equipment middleman
one_liner: Find closing restaurants, contract equipment, pre-sell on restaurant marketplaces before taking inventory risk.
why_agent_runnable: Closing-signal research, comps, buyer matching, and contract/listing drafts are agent-native. Brandon handles identity, contracts, payment, and logistics gates.

ops_steps.title: Closing-signal radar
ops_steps.detail: Mine public FBMP, local news, health permits, and 'restaurant equipment' listings for closing signals in target geos.

ops_steps.title: Buyer demand book
ops_steps.detail: Build wishlist of gear categories (ovens, hoods, refrigeration) with recent sold comps on restaurant marketplaces.

ops_steps.title: Brandon geo + legal box
ops_steps.detail: Approve geos, max deposit risk, and whether to use simple assignment contracts (legal review as needed).

ops_steps.title: Seller outreach drafts
ops_steps.detail: Draft FBMP/email scripts for owners liquidating — no send without Brandon.

ops_steps.title: Pre-sell listings
ops_steps.detail: Draft buyer-facing listings with photos/specs; publish only after Brandon gate and clear title path.

ops_steps.title: Match + paperwork
ops_steps.detail: Bill of sale templates, escrow checklist, pickup logistics SOPs. Brandon signs/pays.

ops_steps.title: Close + CRM
ops_steps.detail: Log deal P&L; propose next targets; no inventory warehouse unless Brandon approves storage spend.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.middleman_spread_notes: Spread is negotiated between distressed seller and hungry buyer; aim to pre-sell before funded buy when possible.
unit_economics_sketch.capital_at_risk_notes: Deposits and transport are main risk if buyer flakes — mitigate with deposits both sides.
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Asset-light when pre-sold. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 5-6: outreach drafts + first seller shortlist
Day 7: Brandon send gate for first 5 seller messages
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 credible closing leads in 21 days
Cannot get seller exclusivity or clear title path
Two deals collapse due to transport/title issues
Brandon declines legal or deposit risk
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
